code_payload: ceil(log2((2B+1)^s)), excluding fixed public dimensions/grid/outcome mask headers
codec_validation: polynomial explicit input/output bit time and space; not a free or workspace-optimal oracle
decoded_matrix: m(dn)^2 Gaussian-integer entries and denominator, separate from compressed payload
trajectory_input: all S bits retained, including longest command identifier and token storage
trajectory_preprocessing: polynomial in explicit input S; total peak is max of preprocessing and postvalidation bound
trajectory_time: expected rejection time/fair bits, bounded storage per trial
programmes: proof representation by genuine quantum operations, not a physical classical communication implementation
